description: Smarte Strasse: Luftqualität Vergleichsmessungen is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Umwelt und Energie. Das Lufthygieneamt beider Basel (LHA) testet im Projekt «Smarte Strasse» kosteneffiziente Mikrosensoren auf ihre Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit. Der installierte Sensor vom Typ «Nubo» der Firma Sensirion AG ist in der Lage, die Konzentration verschiedener Schadstoffe in der Luft in Echtzeit zu ermitteln. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Territory and environment. Its keywords are Smarte Strasse, Luftqualität, Feinstaub, PM2.5, O3, NO2. The portal shows 19,381 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
